run_parity_training: run the parity-check training script with curriculum learning on a TransformerWrapper model
create_data_generator: create a data generator that yields random binary sequences with cumulative-sum parity labels
build_transformer_model: build a TransformerWrapper model with Decoder layers and optional GRU hybrid attention
test_model_generalization: test the trained model's generalization across multiple sequence lengths
refactor_curriculum_learning: refactor the curriculum learning loop to increment sequence length based on loss threshold criteria
